correctness.rationale: For a five-set S, the retained graph in C_{k+5}^2 disconnects exactly when at least two cyclic runs of S have length at least two. Hence facets have run types (3,2) and (2,2,1), giving f_4=n[(k-1)+C(k-1,2)]=nk(k-1)/2. Four-faces have exactly types (3,1),(2,2),(2,1,1), giving f_3=n[k+k/2+C(k,2)]=nk(k+2)/2, and every three-set extends. Independent exhaustive reconstruction for k=3,...,7 reproduced the complete face vector and Euler formula; the all-k proof is the run count.
